context:
Goal: an Opus grant ends in a way that never lingers or cuts off early.
Problem (rule): Today a plain Opus ask writes a file that ends 2 hours later, for the whole session, including agents it spawns. PR #2928 (passed review) instead ends the grant at your next typed prompt or after 2 hours, for the session's own spawns only; it is narrower. Your 779 answer says build the agent-end read but switch only once it works well. It does not say which end is used meanwhile. Cutting #2928 back to today's 2-hour file drops its next-prompt end and needs a new review round.
Based on (ruling): own-779-b-agent-end-later (triage's reading of your words, unconfirmed); lane's report 18:33 CST.
Departs from: main — a keeps main's 2-hour file and cuts #2928 back; b merges #2928's narrower end as the interim.
Meanwhile: the lane changes no code and both PRs wait.
home: ruling own-779-b-agent-end-later; step opus-ask-grants-one-spawn; PRs #2850 and #2928
